sections.Profile:
The Carni-Ball has rolled into town, and the player works its midway by riding attractions, playing carnival games and getting a reading from the fortune teller Tiltara, all while the place grows stranger after closing time. Deluxia Studios' software game for the Multimorphic P3 runs on the Weird Al's Museum of Natural Hilarity playfield module and transforms at its halfway mark, changing every mode.

- Manufacturer: Deluxia Studios
- Years made: 2026
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
